name: Bodyguard for Hire
summary: Cork Gizelton and Rigger would normally lead their kodo past the Kolkar centaur village, yet they stop whenever the centaur war drums are heard. Cork asks you to protect the caravan past the Kolkar village, and payment is waiting with Smeed Scrabblescrew, a bit down the road.

sections.title: War Drums
sections.body: Cork Gizelton and Rigger would normally take their kodo straight past the Kolkar centaur. Now and then the centaur war drums are heard, and the caravan stops, because dead traders make no profit. Cork asks you to guard the caravan past the Kolkar village, a short distance, and keep it in one piece. The caravan waits north of the Kolkar Village and southeast of Thunder Axe Fortress.

sections.title: Smeed Scrabblescrew
sections.body: Payment waits with Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp, a bit down the road. Smeed does a little business with the Gizelton caravan.

faq.answer: Cork Gizelton leads a kodo caravan through Desolace together with Rigger. The two of them stop whenever the centaur war drums sound.

faq.q: Why does the caravan need protection?
faq.answer: Cork and Rigger stop whenever the centaur war drums sound, because dead traders make no profit.
North of the Kolkar Village, and southeast of Thunder Axe Fortress.
With Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp, a bit down the road. Smeed does a little business with Cork.
